programme.title: Cesar Millan’s Leader of the Pack

programme.title: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programme.desc: Cesar works with a Mexican breed close to his heart when he rehabilitates twin dogs whose over-excited behavior has put their owner at risk of eviction from her apartment building. Later, an actress turns to Cesar for help with an overprotective pint-sized pooch that's creating too much drama of her own.

programme.title: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programme.desc: Cesar helps a family of seven with their young Rottweiler, who's grown aggressive and territorial after a burglary at the family home. Parents of a young Pitsky with an overactive prey drive toward their cats look to Cesar for guidance to bring order and harmony into their home.
